# Zero-touch OS provisioning: PXE installs & galleries 🟡

**Goal.** Go from 'boots the network' to 'installs an OS with no keystrokes' across Anaconda/kickstart and debian-installer/preseed — then pick any variant from an upstream gallery.

**Audience:** you can serve + netboot; now install an OS unattended  
**Effort:** ⏱ half-day+  
**Prerequisites:** [The netboot pipeline: build → serve → boot](path-netboot-pipeline.md)

| # | Lab | You'll learn | Checkpoint (observable) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | [`almalinux-pxe-lab`](../almalinux-pxe-lab/) 🔗 | zero-touch AlmaLinux 9 via an Anaconda kickstart. | Anaconda installs with no keystrokes; the second boot comes off disk. |
| 2 | [`rocky-pxe-lab`](../rocky-pxe-lab/) 🔗 | the Rocky twin (+ the CIQ Lorax real-hardware path). | the full ~15-min install completes and reboots into the OS. |
| 3 | [`debian-pxe-lab`](../debian-pxe-lab/) 🔗 | the debian-installer + preseed cousin (not Anaconda) — plain Debian 13 (trixie), the UPSTREAM of the whole d-i family, distilled from Debian's official example. | an unattended preseed install completes and reboots into trixie; `lsblk` shows the atomic layout (`vda1` ext4 `/`, `vda5` swap). |
| 4 | [`kali-pxe-lab`](../kali-pxe-lab/) 🔗 | the same d-i + preseed machinery on Kali (the offensive-distro sibling of debian-pxe-lab). | a preseed install completes; explain the `vda`-pinning that stops d-i clobbering the iPXE ROM disk. |
| 5 | [`libvirt-ipxe-http-pxe`](../libvirt-ipxe-http-pxe/) 🔗 | libvirt's own iPXE ROM fetches the DHCP bootfile over HTTP — no TFTP; then TLS verified vs the lab CA. | the whole flow comes off one `python3 -m http.server`; with the `https/` extension a rogue cert makes iPXE refuse. |
| 6 | [`virtualbmc-ipmi-lab`](../virtualbmc-ipmi-lab/) | give a VM an IPMI BMC and drive it like bare metal — `ipmitool … bootdev pxe`. | power round-trip, then a PXE kickstart install, then `bootdev disk` boots the OS you just provisioned (the OpenStack-Ironic lifecycle in miniature). |
| 7 | [`bmc-toolkit`](../bmc-toolkit/) 🎛️ | now go deeper on the out-of-band protocols themselves: one verb surface (`bmc.sh`) over vbmcd (IPMI power) + ipmi_sim (REAL Serial-over-LAN, RMCP+) + redfish (virtual media — hand the node an ISO and boot it, no PXE), with a capability model a control plane routes on. | `ipmitool -I lanplus … sol activate` streams a node's serial (real SOL), and Redfish `InsertMedia` boots an ISO over virtual media — both headless & rootless (`bash tools/tests/test-control-pane.sh` → 3 passed, 1 skipped). |
| 8 | [`metal-as-a-service`](../metal-as-a-service/) 🏗️ | now COMPOSE the OOB layer + the installers into a control plane: each libvirt domain is a node with a full Ironic-faithful state machine (enroll→manage→inspect→provide→deploy→rescue/release); `deploy` is a pluggable driver interface with health-gated activation + A/B rollback + an F2 signature gate (a tampered image never activates — it rolls back to the previous good one); an inspection RAM probe POSTs schedulable facts to a NoCloud metadata service; and `watch` wires the fleet into tools/control-pane for live progress bars. maas-lab.sh never calls ipmitool — it shells out to bmc-toolkit through one injectable seam, so the whole machine drives headlessly. | `bash examples/metal-as-a-service/tests/run-all.sh` → 11 passed: the state machine REFUSES every illegal transition; `cleaning` hands the disk wipe to the operator; the probe's facts round-trip into a schedulable summary; `watch` drives the real control-pane engine to its terminal milestone; and a health-failing OR byte-tampered image (real OpenSSL CMS) rolls the node back to its previous good image instead of bricking; and a chaos matrix injects a fault at every point a deploy can break — including killing the control plane mid-transition — with ZERO of them becoming a critical failure.<br>🔎 auto-checkable → marker `MAAS-SPINE-OK` 🖥️ |
| 9 | [`FREEBSD-simple-templating-serving-RHEL-kickstart-files`](../FREEBSD-simple-templating-serving-RHEL-kickstart-files/) | a FreeBSD box `sed`-templates a kickstart and serves AlmaLinux via an OEMDRV ISO (no PXE at all). | `ksvalidator` passes the rendered `ks.cfg`; the OEMDRV ISO builds on both GNU and BSD `sed`. |
| 10 | [`rocky-kickstart-gallery`](../rocky-kickstart-gallery/) | install any of ~34 upstream Rocky-9 kickstart variants. | `select-kickstart.sh GenericCloud-Base` then a zero-touch install boots off disk. |
| 11 | [`kali-preseed-gallery`](../kali-preseed-gallery/) | pick from ~15 upstream Kali preseed variants. | `select-preseed.sh headless-default` installs; explain the `/dev/sda`→`/dev/vda` auto-patch. |
| 12 | [`debian-preseed-gallery`](../debian-preseed-gallery/) | the Debian gallery — six partitioning variants (regular/lvm/crypto/home/multi/minimal) GENERATED from Debian's one official example, not fetched from an upstream catalog like Kali's. | `select-preseed.sh crypto-atomic` installs; `lsblk` shows LUKS → LVM. Explain why Debian derives variants where Kali fetches them.<br>🔎 auto-checkable → marker `GEN-OK` 🖥️ |
| 13 | [`debian-hands-off-install`](../debian-hands-off-install/) | push d-i preseeding to its limit: Philip Hands' Hands-Off FRAMEWORK — a chained preseed (`preseed/run`) that GPG-bootstraps trust then COMPOSES the real preseed live from per-class fragments (`auto-install/classes=`). | the class-assembled install reaches a `debian login:`; `dpkg -l molly-guard pwgen` shows the framework's own defaults (proof a composed preseed, not a static file, drove it). |
| 14 | [`almalinux-kickstart-gallery`](../almalinux-kickstart-gallery/) | the AlmaLinux Packer kickstarts — where the `sda`→`vda` rewrite is load-bearing. | `select-kickstart.sh gencloud` installs; the fetch fails closed if any `sda` survives the rewrite. |
| 15 | [`control-pane`](../control-pane/) 📊 | the capstone: stop reading static states — *watch* these installs happen. A headless-first progress engine turns a node's console into a live progress bar from a user-editable `milestones.toml` (regex→label→at%/terminal), no TUI. | `control-pane watch --profile install <console>` fills the bar 25%→55%→85%→100% and prints `reached 'first boot' (100%)`; 14 engine/loader unit tests pass headless (`bash tools/tests/test-control-pane.sh`). |
